original_status.granite_stop: RemoteDisconnected during the third cell; original infrastructure policy halted the cohort

interpretation.kind: Separately registered exploratory replication on a fresh hosted CI VM
interpretation.note: Source and prompts remain fixed, but host, preparation, interpreter and compiler identities are recorded anew. A changed outcome cannot isolate a memory effect or repair the original incomplete study.

frozen_execution.source_bindings: Exactly the original 31 registered Python source hashes; reject any drift before copying, registration, each model and final readout
frozen_execution.prompts_schemas_fixtures: Exactly the original prompt/schema inventory and canonical fixtures
frozen_execution.models: Both original fixed official GGUF sizes, revisions and SHA-256 values, in original order
frozen_execution.runtime: The original fixed llama.cpp b11669 archive SHA-256
frozen_execution.cells: Complete two-family by four-task by three-arm plan; no suffix resume, replacement or selective family
frozen_execution.unchanged: All original source admission, native provider requirements, public/hidden feedback rules, per-cell hard timeout, owned-process restart, identity checks and descriptive gates

resource_admission.cpu: Minimum of affinity and every visible finite cgroup CPU quota
resource_admission.memory: Host MemAvailable and every visible finite cgroup memory.max minus memory.current must each meet the threshold
resource_admission.unlimited: Explicit max means no limit at that node. A missing limit interface is accepted only at a proven visible hierarchy root or where parent/child controller metadata proves that controller inactive; unknown cases reject.
resource_admission.failure: Retain the observation and stop before any next completion; do not lower the threshold, change resources or automatically retry
resource_admission.scope: Observed admission conditions, not hardware isolation, a guaranteed bound throughout a run, or remote attestation
resource_admission.unsupported_hierarchies: Any v1 or hybrid membership is explicitly rejected rather than treating unknown CPU or memory limits as unlimited.

qualification.toolchains: Signed LLVM 20 repository and Rust 1.95.0; actual compiler identities bound by fresh controls and reused unchanged in both families

execution.host: A fresh GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 x86_64 VM
execution.wrapper_deadline_interpretation: An outer infrastructure safety deadline, never a model success or an implicit shorter accepted per-request budget. If exhausted, clean only owned process groups, retain the incomplete cohort, and use the reserved interval for finalization/upload.
execution.launch: Push to the specified branch whose current head commit message contains the unique marker exactly once, or explicit workflow_dispatch with that exact marker; GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT must be 1
execution.on_infrastructure_failure: Stop the entire new cohort, preserve all raw evidence and unattempted cells; do not append or restart
execution.cross_run_single_use: One fixed workflow concurrency group serializes push and dispatch. Before any model preparation, read and retain current run and every bounded workflow-history API response. Only the earliest eligible marker push or dispatch on the registered branch qualifies; earlier failed, cancelled, queued or ambiguous dispatch runs consume the study. Missing metadata, repeated attempts, incomplete pagination, or reaching 1000 entries refuses. No status-dependent retry.
execution.deadline_origin: The 270-minute inference/preparation deadline is measured from the first bootstrap monotonic timestamp when available, so checkout and Python setup consume that budget. Finalization has an independent 20-minute budget and staging five minutes. The 30-minute reserve is an operational target; hard job cancellation or upload/provider failures can still truncate retention and must be reported.
execution.process_cleanup_scope: Every wrapper child owns a new process group, with waitid(WNOWAIT) retaining its PID until the group is signalled and the direct owner reaped. Original llama servers inherit that group. The frozen HIA object compiler may create an independent bounded Clang session; outer kills cannot prove every descendant closed. Preserve actual engine.close receipts and unknown shutdowns; incomplete cohorts remain ineligible and final fresh-VM disposal is the containment boundary.

measured: installation subprocess wall and child CPU/maxRSS
bounded regular-file artifact staging and per-file readback
unknown: artifact upload until separately observed by CI
costs.nesting: Parent intervals include children. Parallel or nested times are not added twice. Missing usage stays null.

retain: all raw cells and native artifacts
actual recovery helper/workflow source and original definitions even on early qualification failure
exclude: downloaded third-party runtime archive and extracted runtime
evidence.upload_scope: Only the separately staged bounded regular-file copy is uploaded. Model weights, downloaded runtime/tool payloads and symlinks are refused; partial staging includes explicit rejected-path/failure receipts. Finalizer failure does not authorize model or archive retries.
